… e and the release command, in text and JSON. N3: each process is pinned by a pidfd and its environment read again through it before SIGKILL, so a reused pid is never signalled. N4: a scan that cannot list `/proc` or read a process state fails; a process of this user whose environment cannot be read is counted and disclosed in the run record rather than skipped (L3).    132	- 2026-11-24: review round 2 (rrn-2c9fa8ac47c2fbab) requested changes. N1: a reservation an earlier engine left without any marker is now listed by `delegate ls` and released by `cancel` once it has no marker, receipt or run and is older than ten minutes (an earlier engine marked within moments of reserving). N2: a non-inspectable process of this user that did not exist before the adapter started may be the run's, so the scan fails and the run stays unconcludable; ones that predate the run are skipped and disclosed. N3: a release claims the attempt exclusively, so two cancels never record two runs. N4: `TestAnInterruptedDispatchIsReleasedAndTheNextOneRuns` interrupts a real dispatch after its reservation, sees the next dispatch refused with the release command, releases it and dispatches again. N5: a receipt that cannot be inspected is reported with its error. Each fix has a test that fails with it mutated out, except N5.

… o, e o motor registra o fulfillment só quando o run é do brief e do bundle do request, de um agente aceito, concluído com sua contenção, sua prova assinada verifica, seu ledger de tentativas está íntegro e o motor registrou sua conclusão no destino do request; o fulfillment é verificado de novo a cada leitura. `pose delegate review <escopo> --request <act-id>` roda o brief do request localmente e submete o run depois de concluído. Um run que rejeita cumpre o request sem aprovar nada; um bundle superado ou uma policy alterada o invalida, mesmo já cumprido, e ele é pedido de novo com `--supersedes <act-id>`, que o aposenta sob as regras de autoridade de supersession (`--authority <json>`, `--role <papel>`, `--requested-at` do preview) ou, quando o plano passa a reservar a review a uma pessoa, faz da escalação para a pessoa o seu sucessor; um retry com a mesma chave e o mesmo run não faz nada. Uma pessoa é chamada por exceção, como decision request ao papel maintainer: um plano que reserva a review a uma pessoa, um orçamento de tentativas esgotado, revisores em conflito e uma `business_decision` que um revisor levantou no draft. POSE.md:1078:**Runs that leave work behind.** On Linux, after the adapter exits, the dispatch also ends every process whose environment names the run's sealed checkout (`POSE_SEALED_CHECKOUT`), which catches commands a reviewer started in a session of its own; each is pinned by a pidfd and checked again before it is signalled. It waits for them and lists them in the run's `safety.limitations` before the cleanup inventory, and discloses there the processes of the same user that predate the run and whose environment could not be read (one started during the run that cannot be read fails the cleanup); on other platforms only the process group is ended; the brief of template `review-brief/10` asks the reviewer to let its commands finish. The dispatch marks an attempt active before it publishes its reservation, so a dispatch that ends before recording its run always leaves a stalled attempt, which `pose delegate ls` lists with its cause, as it does a reservation an earlier engine left without a marker once it is ten minutes old; `pose delegate cancel <attempt>` releases it once its owner is proven gone, recording a failed run and its receipt.
